title.en: gran balon, the antiques market on the second sunday.
title.de: gran balon, der antikmarkt am zweiten sonntag.
title.tr: gran balon, ayın ikinci pazarında antika pazarı.

line.en: the big antiques and vintage market, borgo dora up to the cortile del maglio, 8 to 18. one sunday a month; this month the 8th.
line.de: der große antik- und vintage-markt, von borgo dora bis zum cortile del maglio, 8 bis 18 uhr. einmal im monat, diesmal der 8.
line.tr: büyük antika ve vintage pazarı, borgo dora'dan cortile del maglio'ya kadar, 8'den 18'e. ayda bir kez, bu ay 8'inde.

sparks.why: Gran Balon, second sunday of the month, 8 nov 2026, 8:00 to 18:00 per guidatorino.com; siviaggia.it's piedmont november 2026 market list has the same date.
